primary.title: Castellum’s major divestment journey in 2026

primary.title: ”The company’s DNA is to own properties primarily in Sweden”
primary.summary: Castellum’s occupancy rate continues to decline, and net leasing—excluding ongoing projects—stands at negative 63 million so far this year.
